Name: SDVE Lance - Reskin and dialogue
Author: OhLookAtThat
Description:
Adjusted Lance's pink hair into a smoldering red and an optional addition of a scar across one eye.

Added few dialogue changes that help Lance feel a little more real, and adds to his unique charm.

Portraits and sprites for [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5975]Stardew Valley Expanded Seasonal Outfits[/url] included as well. 

This reskin was created specifically for the character Lance, in [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/3753]Stardew Valley Expanded[/url]. This reskin requires this mod.

To use, please replace the Lance character sprite files and portrait files in your Stardew Valley Expanded and Seasonal Outfits for SVE mod folders with the respective SDVE Lance - Reskin and Dialogue files. File paths can be found in the Read Me. 

Enjoy <3 

-OhLookAtThat
